rds_parser.implementation: base R readRDS via Rscript; no project R analysis code is executed
rds_parser.required_object_type: data.frame or subclass accepted by is.data.frame
rds_parser.temporary_transport: write.table UTF-8 TSV in a private temporary directory; temporary row-level exports are deleted before exit and are never uploaded

cohort.eligibility: every species with >=2 distinct 90s positive physical nodes
cohort.species_order: lexicographic after exact README-defined species strings are stripped

once_only_execution_order: download and verify both frozen RDS files
parse both complete RDS objects with the frozen parser
validate exact schemas and year/period consistency
construct response-independent habitat scaling and thresholds
join catch to habitat under frozen keys
derive the full eligible species cohort from 90s positives only
for each eligible species evaluate all 35 worlds on 90s positives
without retuning evaluate all 2023 positive physical nodes as hard witnesses
write summary certificate only; do not persist raw parsed rows
primary_outputs: per-heldout-positive number/fraction of calibration survivors falsified
secondary_outputs: species with no heldout positive witnesses
species with complete heldout falsification of calibration survivor fiber
species retaining multiple worlds after all positive evidence
aggregate distribution of survivor contraction fractions
claim_boundary: retrospective external bridge, not fresh confirmatory evidence
primary empirical scope is A/M with B unrestricted
positive records are hard witnesses; 2023 nondetections are not absences
survivor contraction is not causal effect size of dams
species with stronger contraction are not ranked as more barrier-sensitive
authorization_amendment_rule: after Gate1 PASS, only status and Gate1 fingerprint may be filled; no other field may change before RDS payload access
